verdict.rationale: Digits documents a first-party Bill Pay product ('Drag. Drop. Approve. Pay.') and a bills workflow API covering ingest, submit, approve and pay, so capture, approval and payment do sit in one native workflow. The evidence does not show payment scheduling (only 'pay') or how approvals are routed to approvers. missing for 10: documented payment scheduling, approval routing details (approvers, multi-step chains), in-depth bill-pay docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Bill Pay Drag. Drop. Approve. Pay.
a complete bills workflow API — ingest, query, submit, approve, pay, reject, void — gated by the bills:manage scope
